colorTheory.description: The color palette combines a classic black and white scheme with a touch of blue for contrast and vibrancy.
colorTheory.mood: The palette exudes professionalism and clarity, with a modern twist from the blue accent color.
colorTheory.accessibility: The high contrast between black text and white background ensures excellent readability. The use of blue for accents provides visual interest without compromising accessibility.
colorTheory.colorRelationships: The primary black and secondary white colors create a clean and crisp foundation, while the blue accent color adds a pop of energy and focus. The success green color stands out distinctively, enhancing positive feedback messages.
